// diagnostic

E0759

`record` reaches `Audit`, a kind of `Log` that `audit.Audit` doesn't allow

What

`record` reaches `Audit`, a kind of `Log` that `audit.Audit` doesn't allow

Why

A row that names a kind of an effect allows only that kind and the kinds of it; another package's kind of the same effect is a different effect

Fix

Name the other kind in the row, name the parent effect itself, or stop calling the function that introduces the other kind

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0759: tests/ui/effects/package_effect_other_kind_is_e0759.stderr.

Error [jet.LibraryEffectKindOutsideRow]: `record` reaches `Metrics`, a kind of `Log` that `Audit` doesn't allow
  --> tests/ui/effects/package_effect_other_kind_is_e0759.jet:12:16
    |
 12 | record: fn() -[Audit]> { count() }
    |                ^^^^^
 Why: A row that names a kind of `Log` allows only that kind and the kinds of it, so `Audit` doesn't cover another package's or another declaration's kind of `Log`
 Fix: Name `Metrics` in `record`'s row, name `Log` itself, or stop calling the function that introduces it
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: record
